ruleDefinitions.name: Tamper Windows Defender - PSClassic
ruleDefinitions.description: Attempting to disable scheduled scanning and other parts of Windows Defender ATP or set default actions to allow. Note: Unmapped fields: Data

sequences.query: Data = RGX(".*Set\\-MpPreference.*") AND ((Data = RGX(".*\\-dbaf\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dbaf\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dbm\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dbm\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dips\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dips\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableArchiveScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableArchiveScanning\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableBehaviorMonitoring\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableBehaviorMonitoring\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupFullScan\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupFullScan\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupQuickScan\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableCatchupQuickScan\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableIOAVProtection\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableIOAVProtection\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableRealtimeMonitoring\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableRealtimeMonitoring\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableRemovableDriveScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableRemovableDriveScanning\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningMappedNetworkDrivesForFullScan\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningNetworkFiles\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScanningNetworkFiles\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScriptScanning\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-DisableScriptScanning\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-MAPSReporting\\ \\$false.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-MAPSReporting\\ 0.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-drdsc\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-drdsc\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-drtm\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-drtm\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dscrptsc\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dscrptsc\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dsmndf\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dsmndf\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dsnf\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dsnf\\ 1.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dss\\ \\$true.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\-dss\\ 1.*")) OR (Data = RGX(".*HighThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*htdefac\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*LowThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*ltdefac\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*ModerateThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*mtdefac\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*SevereThreatDefaultAction\\ Allow.*") OR Data = RGX(".*stdefac\\ Allow.*")))
